queries.sql:
SELECT c.calc_id, c.account_code, c.expression, c.depends_on, c.statement_section,
                c.calc_version, c.rationale, c.is_active, c.updated_by, c.updated_at,
                a.account_name, a.account_type, a.is_leaf
         FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_CALC_DEFINITION c
         JOIN SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT a ON c.account_code = a.account_code
         WHERE c.is_active = TRUE
         ORDER BY a.sort_order

SELECT account_code, account_name, account_type, statement_section, parent_account_code, is_leaf, sort_order
         FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT
         WHERE is_active = TRUE
         ORDER BY sort_order
